Maya C.: FYI — Hemlock finished onboarding call a few minutes ago. Quick raw wishlist from their CS lead below.
Maya C.: 1) Per-department/per-team cost breakdown in console or export; 2) ability to pin model variant per route so devs can lock for prod; 3) clearer token-cost export that maps to seats/onboarding users.
Cathy (Hemlock): thanks! biggest pain right now is not being able to show cost by department for internal chargebacks.
Jon P.: Q — do they need live RBAC-spliting or would a scheduled export (CSV) be acceptable as a stopgap? @Cathy (Hemlock)
Cathy (Hemlock): CSV for now is fine but they consider team-level split a renewal gating ask.
Ava L.: product note: maps to billing-exports (quick), model-pin (medium), team-cost-splits (larger). Will tag accordingly.
Maya C.: Can we triage priority? This customer is mid-enterprise, renewal in ~6 weeks. Renewal risk if team-cost-splits not addressed.
Jon P.: Tentative priorities: team-cost-splits = P1 (renewal blocker), model-pin = P2, CSV export = P2 (quick win). @Ava L. can you give a rough scoping number?
Ava L.: rough estimate: team-cost-splits ~ 2 sprints (infra + UI), model-pin ~ 1 sprint, CSV export ~ <3 days (backend endpoint + short UI).
Maya C.: ok — I'll add P1 flag to the Hemlock account in CRM and surface in renewal packet. Also we should draft an enablement workaround for them (how-to export + mapping guidance).
Jon P.: I'll create a short product ticket and link Hemlock account, include why it's P1 (renewal).
Maya C.: @cs-bot please remind me to follow up with Hemlock in 5 days after we have the ticket:thumbsup:
cs-bot: Reminder set for 5 days for @Maya C..
Maya C.: Thanks — moving to #product-wishlist and adding notes to the onboarding thread for Hemlock.
